title: Love Story
predictedRatingReason: Predicted 3.5★: Ryan Murphy anthology on the JFK Jr./Bessette romance — a 1990s cultural moment with the tabloid press as the systemic villain. Lands on American Crime Story 3.5★ together, Murphy's other true-story anthology, and on Quiz 3.5★ ("I enjoy watching how a cultural moment unfolds"). Together: prestige true story with period feel is Helen's lane (Daisy Jones 4★). Style over substance is the risk — critics split at 81%, and both Scandals dropped at 2★ on unlikeable leads. These leads read as magnetic, which is the difference. Returning anthology, S1 complete. Strict 2-episode test.
predictedBingeabilityReason: Binge 4/5: Nine 50-minute episodes on a famous romance running toward a known tragedy — dramatic irony supplies the pull, helped by a 90s-nostalgia soundtrack. The recurring knock is "adds nothing new", a quality complaint rather than a momentum one, so the level holds. Grabs from ep 1.
